_help: phrases = ids in picker order (their words: content/text/en.json "emotes"). limits = this device: up to burst in a row, one back every refillSeconds, never two closer than minGapMs. server = the room's own count (never looser than limits) + perMatch, the most one seat may send in a match. bubble = how long one shows: showMs, or readMsPerWord x its words if longer. mutedByDefault = the "Hide everyone's emotes" switch's starting value.
